bio.text: John Zaccaro Jr. represents District 80 in the New York State Assembly, according to the Assembly's member directory.
According to his official biography, he was born and raised in the Bronx and lives in the Pelham Parkway section of the borough.

The biography says he was Chief of Staff to City Councilmember Rafael Salamanca and Bronx Director for Intergovernmental Affairs under Schools Chancellor Carmen Farina, and previously served on Bronx Community Board 7.
